title: Manual Resolve
description: manual-resolve/v1 — a party asking to discharge the report's obligation without any collateral moving, because it was settled between the parties outside the platform or the call no longer stands. Either party may ask; the counterparty answers, and the request is already the requester's own consent. Nothing closes until it is accepted, and a refusal ends nothing — the exceptions stay open, so the requester may ask again with new grounds or post after all. The exceptions it answers are the ones the event CITES in its reference list, and only those: a copy in the body is ignored.

manualResolveId.description: Identity of this request, minted by the facade and handed to clients, who answer it by id through the collateral API. On the log the answer cites this event instead.

reportId.description: The report whose obligation would be discharged.

exceptionIds.description: Ignored by the router, which takes this from the event's reference list instead: the citation is checked at admission and signed, a copy in the body is neither. Kept so events written before it was derived still validate.

reason.description: Why closing without collateral is appropriate — not a restatement of why the leg failed, which the exception already carries.
